The unknown ore discovered in my hometown’s
bedrock possesses the positive qualities of multiple
existing ores. Perhaps it’s not a single type of ore,
but rather a mix of more than one?

It would be a challenge to perform sufficient
experimentation with just the sample I managed to
bring here, but I sense some great potential...

Assuming someone actually DOES complete my
mission for me by getting food and furniture and all
that stockpiled up...

What should I do if they actually want to join
our organization?

I dunno if any super serious do-gooders would want
to join Team R, but if they DO ask to join I guess we
could let ’em. Might not be so bad.

I bet everybody’d be real surprised if they found out
Team R built a rocket to evacuate into outer space all
by ourselves.

We even have more than enough fuel to make it back
to the planet easily after the environment’s calmed
down a bit. The boss’s plan is absolutely perfect!

The boss says that the scale of the plan to get all
humans into outer space at once is just too large.

He said that if anything goes seriously wrong, the
others might not have enough fuel to get back!

Maybe we could share some of our extra fuel with
them if that happens. Then maybe people’d think
“Oh, Team R is actually so nice”, and we’d get more
people wanting to join up.

Either way, I bet we can make a bunch of money from
it all when the time comes!

August 21 — Sunny
I was reading my diary from last year earlier today.
On this day one year ago, I was having a contest with
my Mudkip (I named it Kip!) to see who could eat the
most watermelon.
Thinking about it made me cry a little. I hope we can
do stuff like that again someday.
